The site stays the focal subject near the centre, with every essential detail inside the central 60% of the width and the middle 45% of the height, so the image survives a wide 21:9 banner crop. A neat rectangular hatch has been cut into the forward hold, its edges still glowing faintly orange from the cutting torch; a portable white work light is left clipped beside the cut. Visiting ship: The visiting Interceptor small in the lower foreground, pulling away toward the warm star, engines lit. It is at most about 15% of the frame's width and never covers the site.
